items.title: 52263_Sonny Greer oral history interview
items.q: Everybody in the band, we idolized him.

ctx.x: So now according to him, he pulled you all out of the band.

No, no way. How the hell could he pull us out of the band? No, he didn't pull us out of no band. Never. The way -- the first time -- they wanted Duke just to go to Europe on something they had over there. So he went and the only one he take with him was Ray Nance, that's all. And one of the singers, Joy Sherrill. So Billy stayed home, Johnny, and Lawrence Brown and I forget who, it was somebody on bass who -- who the hell played bass with us?
